concerns.text: FR-002 (MICE imputation) and FR-009 (variable validation) lack a functional implementation path. Task T016 (imputation) and T016a (write to disk) are marked incomplete, and T013b (post-imputation validation) depends on them. Without these tasks being executable, the pipeline cannot satisfy the missing data handling requirement.

FR-008 (Output) requires exporting regression coefficients and diagnostics. Task T021 is marked incomplete, leaving the spec requirement unmet. No other task explicitly covers the generation of `data/processed/regression_coefficients.csv` or `data/processed/model_diagnostics.json`.

FR-007 (Sensitivity Analysis) requires a threshold sensitivity sweep. Task T028a is marked incomplete, and no other task covers the implementation of the sweep logic or the generation of `data/processed/sensitivity_sweep_results.csv`.
FR-009 (Data Integrity) requires a pre-imputation variable check. Task T013a is marked incomplete, breaking the dependency chain for downstream preprocessing tasks (T014a, T014b, T016).

Plan Execution Flow Step 8 and FR-012 (Final Report) require a main entry point (`code/main.py`). Task T052 is marked incomplete and has a conflicting duplicate entry at the end of the file, leaving the orchestration of the pipeline unimplemented.

FR-006 (Error Correction) requires family-wise error correction for the primary interaction hypothesis. Task T029a is marked incomplete, and while T029 mentions the correction, the specific implementation for the primary interaction test is not covered by a completed task.

Plan constraints (Compute/Memory) and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) require dynamic resource checking. Tasks T050 (RAM check for data) and T051 (RAM check for bootstrap) are marked incomplete, leaving the pipeline unsafe for the specified free CPU runner environment.
